observedCauseAndBoundary.explanation: The completed map and its row references use the same locally generated 89-reference namespace. All 1,950 explicit row pairs checked match their digest in that embedded table; within-map mismatch count is zero. The separate 141-entry portable index uses a conflicting namespace: all 89 same-number labels have different digests. The SHA-keyed entries below are a namespace-qualified lookup aid only. Never substitute standalone-index labels into the original map without reindexing its embedded table and all references together. The map creator script documents its sorted-path enumeration; no creator for the separate index was found, so the origin of the second namespace cannot be attributed.

scope: Mechanical reconciliation of SHA-explicit opaque reference pairs in the existing complete V7 map, its embedded reference table, and the portable forecast against the separate portable private-evidence index. No source evidence content was read or included; no semantic adequacy, test, or PASS judgment is made.

mapCreatorRecord.relevantBehavior: Enumerates a sorted private_paths list into a local refmap, then scrubs row paths and builds the embedded 89-entry table from that same mapping (lines 44-65). This establishes the embedded map namespace. No creator for the separate 141-entry standalone index was present among the inspected V7 delivery records; its precise generation cause cannot be attributed.
